items.note: The 24-hour reminder can be sent after the 2-hour reminder With lead times `[24, 2]`, add a task due at 10:00 UTC and first evaluate it at 08:30. The evaluator returns `2h`. Save that stage and evaluate again at 09:30. It returns `24h`, so the second alert is less urgent even though the deadline is closer. Reproduced by calling `evaluateDueReminders` twice with those timestamps and carrying the first result forward in `remindedStages`. Once a more urgent stage has fired, suppress less urgent stages for that deadline. The overdue stage should still be eligible. [Reminder stage selection]( )
